 Bears heading into bye week with expectations for Luther Burden continuing to grow 
 By Nick Halden | Nov 12, 2026, 11:05 AM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Nov 8, 2026; Chicago, Illinois, USA; Chicago Bears wide receiver Luther Burden III (10) scores a touchdown against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the first half at Soldier Field. Mandatory Credit: Matt Marton-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect One of the more exciting aspects of the 2026 season for the Chicago Bears is the emergence of receiver Luther Burden. While Caleb Williams has done a nice job spreading the ball around, Burden is in the middle of what is a clear step forward piling up 644 receiving yards and four touchdowns, on track for what will be considered a breakout season. 
--> One of the more exciting aspects of the 2026 season for the Chicago Bears is the emergence of receiver Luther Burden. While Caleb Williams has done a nice job spreading the ball around, Burden is in the middle of what is a clear step forward piling up 644 receiving yards and four touchdowns, on track for what will be considered a breakout season. 
 This is the exact version of the pass catcher that Chicago fans were hopeful of finding after the draft selection was made. 
--> This is the exact version of the pass catcher that Chicago fans were hopeful of finding after the draft selection was made. 
 Burden has been a nice mix of explosive and clutch offering Williams a consistent target. Even when the starting quarterback was out of the lineup, the receiver found ways to stay involved and play an important role. If there is one critique or area fans would like to see improved it is the two fumbles on the season including last week against Tampa Bay. 
--> Burden has been a nice mix of explosive and clutch offering Williams a consistent target. Even when the starting quarterback was out of the lineup, the receiver found ways to stay involved and play an important role. If there is one critique or area fans would like to see improved it is the two fumbles on the season including last week against Tampa Bay. 
 The receiver is slightly built and at times this can make protecting the ball or fighting through contact a bit more difficult. The flip side of this is pointing out how much Burden's speed impacts the game consistently finding ways to slip open and present the quarterback chances whether it is to push the ball down the field or even underneath to help keep the chains moving.

The flip side of this is pointing out how much Burden's speed impacts the game consistently finding ways to slip open and present the quarterback chances whether it is to push the ball down the field or even underneath to help keep the chains moving. 
 Everything about Burden's season has been a step forward thus far, and it is fun to take the bye week and reflect on the clear improvements. This is the consistency and impact that Bears fans were hoping the franchise might find, and what was hinted at from Burden's summer. 
--> Everything about Burden's season has been a step forward thus far, and it is fun to take the bye week and reflect on the clear improvements. This is the consistency and impact that Bears fans were hoping the franchise might find, and what was hinted at from Burden's summer. 
 Bears fans can't help but take bye week to appreciate leap forward Luther Burden has taken
--> Bears fans can't help but take bye week to appreciate leap forward Luther Burden has taken
 What will be interesting to continue to watch is how Williams spreads the football around as Burden becomes more of an established threat. Opposing teams are going to be forced to make difficult coverage choices and Burden will help open up other chances for his fellow pass catchers. This is the level of impact the receiver is having and speaks to exactly to why Chicago remains excited about their offensive future.

Opposing teams are going to be forced to make difficult coverage choices and Burden will help open up other chances for his fellow pass catchers. This is the level of impact the receiver is having and speaks to exactly to why Chicago remains excited about their offensive future. 
 Looking at Burden's numbers it is on the table we see a jump in touchdowns perhaps allowing the pass catcher to reach double digits while the yardage total will be well over 1,000. This has been a breakout season, one that fans will continue to enjoy and lean on in difficult divisional matchups ahead.

 For Burden, there is now a clear lack of pressure as the talent has been made obvious and the effort is clearly consistent. The only question remains whether there is another gear yet to be found or if Burden has fully reached a potential that would have the receiver in the conversation as one of the league's best options.
